statements.text: On cosmopsychism a human consciousness is an aspect of the consciousness of the universe, grounded by subsumption, so it can be part of reality as it is in itself. Both a whole and its aspects can be privileged. This is why cosmopsychism is the more plausible form of constitutive panpsychism.

sources.quote: The crucial advantage of cosmopsychism, as opposed to micropsychism, is that it does not require a deflationary view of o-subjects and their experiences.
If we want to take advantage of the theoretical benefits of constitutive panpsychism, then we should embrace cosmopsychism.
